dx_raw:
**DIAGNOSIS:** Ischemic (microvascular/diabetic) oculomotor (third cranial) nerve palsy with pupillary involvement in newly diagnosed diabetes mellitus, presenting with severe hyperglycemia (likely diabetic ketoacidosis)

**Alternatives:**
1. Acute ophthalmoparesis / Miller Fisher syndrome variant (anti-GQ1b antibody syndrome) — post-infectious cranial polyneuropathy
2. Inflammatory or infectious cranial neuritis (e.g., Lyme disease, neurosyphilis, sarcoidosis, tuberculous basal meningitis)
3. Paraneoplastic or autoimmune cranial neuropathy / brainstem encephalitis (e.g., lymphoma, anti-neuronal antibody syndrome)
